text: Standing in the corridor and looking into this sleek, glass-walled room fills me with curiosity and anticipation. The clear demarcation between the ordinary hallway and the vibrant, information-packed exhibit inside makes the threshold feel meaningful—as though I am standing at the boundary between the mundane and the realm of ideas. The quiet hum of lights and screens, the crisp air, and the modern decor suggest progress and innovation. I feel both small amid the mechanisms of knowledge, and eager to immerse myself in discovery.
